banking-economy.title: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reports cyberattack involving its bank account
banking-economy.summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial encountered a cyber fraud incident with unauthorized transactions on November 1. The amount involved was approximately 78 million rupees, which was transferred to multiple beneficiary accounts. Upon detection, the company promptly stopped affected services and notified its bank. A request for reversal and account freezing was also made to the bank. Additionally, Spandana registered a complaint with the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
